title: Only the engine's owner calls the door's first form
requirement: until the door can be reached from another host, only the engine's owner on the engine's host can call it; a call by another account on that host is refused
observed_gap: `Door inside the engine's process` carries "owner only" on P-118's authority; P-093 says "on the engine's own host only".
acceptance: Before the door can be reached from another host, a call by the engine's owner on the engine's host is answered and a call by another account on the same host is refused.
